method: Actual PersonalHistory observe(text), tokenize, nextWords, recall; synthetic local text only

findings.issue: Curly outer quotation marks are retained as token content and break word-pair learning
findings.result: Stores “merhaba” instead of merhaba; no bana→merhaba or merhaba→dedi pairs
findings.controls: ASCII double quotes, guillemets and parentheses strip correctly
findings.duplicate_evidence: Combined plain/ASCII/curly inputs produce merhaba count2 and “merhaba” count1; curly version becomes recallable

findings.issue: Single-letter Turkish pronoun o excluded as prediction target
findings.result: o not stored and bu→o / ben→o not learned
findings.controls: bu→odur, ben→onu and o→geldi are learned
findings.classification: Functional coverage gap from explicit minimum-length policy; not a random crash or data corruption

negative_controls: İZMİR/İzmir/izmir and IŞIK/ışık normalize and retrieve next-word predictions correctly in these cases
relation_to_previous: Curly apostrophe inside a word was round5; this tests outer quote trimming and duplicate token identity. Capitalization after quotes (round16) is a separate consumer.
limits: No UI import interaction in this round
Does not imply all quotation styles should always be discarded
